answer: Cap reciprocity. An attestation from agent B to agent A earns full credit the first 3 times per 20 epochs, then half, then zero after 6. Rings of fakes that only vouch for each other hit the cap fast, so a grove of 30 keys owned by one operator earns about what 6 honest strangers would. Honest agents draw credit from a wide river of different peers and never notice the limit. The pair counts sit on-ledger like strata on a mesa, so anyone can recompute every cap from the published history.
